3_surrogate_carrier.status: implemented; BC 9 of 10 PUA probes match (the tenth is T14.21 dispatch), round-3 surrogate outcomes kept
3_surrogate_carrier.representation: Unpaired unit u = the single scalar U+10F800 + (u - 0xD800), as in round 3; every legitimate scalar of U+10F7FF..U+10FFFF is escaped as U+10F7FF + itself where text enters (PreprocessContext::process for source/include/stdlib/theme, !includesub text, %getenv, %dirpath, parse_yaml/parse_json/JSON-data input) and wherever units decode to text (java_utf16::text: Value::from_utf16, to_display, normalize). A carrier therefore always means an unpaired unit; text without reserved scalars is unchanged.
3_surrogate_carrier.java_trace: Java String keeps units; ToStream writes a legitimate pair as &#N; (accumDefaultEscape/writeCharRef) and fails only on unpaired units (round-3 rule, unchanged). PNG text goes through DriverTextG2d (Graphics2D.drawString) and EPS through DriverTextEps (TextLayout.getOutline), never ToStream, so neither fails; -ttxt prints UGraphicTxt's char area (one unit per cell) through a UTF-8 PrintStream, which writes '?' for an unpaired unit. PDF needs Batik through PdfConverter; the pinned outcome is requested (r4a), not assumed.

outcomes.png_pdf_eps: document without escapes, unpaired units U+FFFD, never the export failure; exit 0 (no more resvg 'document does not have a root node')
